title: Configure system proxy in GNOME
summary: Set manual proxy settings for GNOME desktop environment using gsettings. This affects applications that respect GNOME network settings, such as Chromium and Firefox.
prerequisites: Know your proxy host and port.

steps.explain: Set the proxy mode to manual.
Set the HTTP proxy host. Replace <PROXY_HOST> with your proxy hostname.

placeholders.name: PROXY_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP address of the proxy server.

steps.explain: Set the HTTP proxy port. Replace <PROXY_PORT> with your proxy port number.

placeholders.name: PROXY_PORT
placeholders.description: The port number of the proxy server.
